coach.title: Drive-cycle coach
coach.help: Checking readiness every 30 s while connected. You'll get a notification as each monitor completes, and once when all are ready.

export.noSharing: Sharing is not available on this device.

clear.title: Clear fault codes?
clear.body: This erases stored codes and resets readiness monitors. Codes will return if the fault persists.

high.label: High
high.hint: Can damage the engine or catalyst, or affect safety. Check it before driving far.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.hint: Needs attention soon (emissions, a control module or a lost connection between modules).

info.label: Info
info.hint: A recorded fault with a known meaning. Check it, but it is rarely urgent on its own.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.hint: No local description for this code. Use the web search or the AI explanation.

detail.footer: Descriptions follow SAE J2012. Causes and fixes vary by car; use the guide and freeze frame before replacing parts.

guide.noFreezeFrame: No freeze frame captured for this code.
